summary: HeatShield SG iteration 3 (Quiet Hours + Route-from-place + PWA install) verified end-to-end. Backend: 44/44 pytest pass on live preview (35 regression from iter 1&2 + 9 new for quiet-hours + PWA assets + cooling-from-alt-origin). Frontend (mobile 390x844, geolocation+notifications granted): admin login → dashboard renders NotificationSettings, SavedPlaces, and all 5 targeted testids without console errors (only pre-login /auth/me 401s). Service worker registers on load with scope /. InstallAppCard correctly hidden in headless Chromium (no beforeinstallprompt + non-iOS UA) — expected per brief. Quiet Hours: toggle ON fires PUT /api/push/quiet-hours {enabled:true,start:22,end:7} (default 22:00→07:00 shown), start/end selects reveal, changing start to 23:00 fires PUT with {start:23,end:7}, /auth/me returns matching quiet_hours, reload preserves ON state and 23:00→07:00. Route-from-place: pre-seeded Home (Woodlands 1.437,103.786) with GPS at Marina Bay (1.283,103.859) — clicking route-place-<id> navigated to /cooling AND cooling page issued GET /api/cooling/spots?lat=1.437&lng=103.786 (Woodlands lat, NOT the GPS one), header shows 'Home', toast 'Finding cooling routes from Home', distances match Woodlands (14.1/15.64/16.31 km). PWA assets all serve correctly: manifest.json valid with 192+512 icons + display=standalone + theme_color #0A58CA, sw.js 200 with push+notificationclick handlers, index.html has manifest link + apple-touch-icon + theme-color meta. All 3 new-iteration user flows PASS.

minor.issue: Still returns 200 with unchanged list when id does not exist (no 404). Carried over from iter 2 — not a blocker.
Does not validate start/end are in 0-23 (server does modulo 24 silently). Not a bug (input is normalized), but a Pydantic Field(ge=0, le=23) constraint would surface bad clients earlier.

AI chat streaming (POST /api/chat) - not-in-scope-this-iteration - no AI code changed; still passes regression pytest TestAI::test_chat_streaming_singapore_advice + test_chat_history_persisted

Web Push (VAPID / pywebpush) - pass (plumbing incl. Quiet Hours) - evidence: PUT /api/push/quiet-hours 200 with {enabled,start,end}, /auth/me exposes quiet_hours field ({'enabled':true,'start':23,'end':7} persisted through reload), monitor_loop code path skips push when in_quiet_hours() returns true (verified by static review of push_service.monitor_loop:85). VAPID key still 65-char base64url starting with B; sw.js showNotification handler intact. OS-level delivery cannot be asserted in headless Chromium (brief-approved). Skill: ai-testing-core (Web Push is not an LLM/audio/image feature).
action_items: (nice-to-have, minor) Add Field(ge=0, le=23) constraint on QuietHoursInput.start and .end so bad input 422s instead of silent modulo.
(carried, minor) Return 404 from DELETE /api/locations/{unknown_id} instead of silent 200.
(iteration 1 leftover, unchanged) Google Maps API key still needs preview origin whitelisted (RefererNotAllowedMapError) — not retested per brief.
critical_code_review_comments: push_service.in_quiet_hours correctly handles both same-day (start<end) and overnight wrap (start>end) windows in SG timezone (UTC+8). Edge case start==end returns False (never quiet) — sensible.
server.py QuietHoursInput uses `int` and stores after `% 24` — safe against bad clients but silently munges (25 -> 1). Consider Pydantic ge/le validators.

InstallAppCard is a clean, correct beforeinstallprompt implementation with iOS Safari fallback text + dismiss persistence in localStorage. It only renders when either a deferred prompt is captured OR the UA is iOS — so headless Chromium NOT showing it is by design (not a bug).

SavedPlaces.routeFrom calls selectLocation() then navigate('/cooling'). AppContext.selectLocation persists to localStorage so /cooling GET spots uses the chosen origin — verified live: GET /api/cooling/spots?lat=1.437&lng=103.786 fired after Route click while GPS was at 1.283.
manifest.json start_url is '.' (relative) — works from any subpath. Icons declare 'any maskable' purpose which is correct for Android adaptive icons.
sw.js requireInteraction=true is retained — good for heat safety UX; tag='heatshield' collapses repeats.
MongoDB _id remains correctly excluded from all authenticated payloads via _public_user; push_subscriptions is now also stripped (addressed my iter-2 security note — good).

AppContext.detectLocation on every mount can still overwrite an active saved-place label with 'Current location' if the browser returns a fresh GPS fix on reload. Verified again in iter-3 route-from-place testing: after Route click, header did say 'Home' — because Route directly calls selectLocation, and /cooling page does not re-detect. But if the user reloads /cooling afterwards, detectLocation may still stomp it. Optional fix: skip detectLocation when a named saved-place is active.
